Interface BeanPostProcessor

All Known Subinterfaces:
DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor, InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor, MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessor, SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor, AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, AbstractAutoProxyCreator, AbstractBeanFactoryAwareAdvisingPostProcessor, AdvisorAdapterRegistrationManager, AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator, AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, AsyncAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, AutowiredAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, BeanNameAutoProxyCreator, BeanValidationPostProcessor, CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, ConcurrencyLimitBeanPostProcessor, DefaultAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, ImportAwareAotBeanPostProcessor, InfrastructureAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, InitDestroyAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, JmsListenerAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, LoadTimeWeaverAwareProcessor, MethodValidationPostProcessor, PersistenceAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, PersistenceExceptionTranslationPostProcessor, RetryAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, ScriptFactoryPostProcessor, ServletContextAwareProcessor, SimpleServletPostProcessor
public interface BeanPostProcessor
Factory hook that allows for custom modification of new bean instances — for example, checking for marker interfaces or wrapping beans with proxies.

通常，通过标记接口等机制填充 Bean 的后处理器将实现postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object, String)，而用代理包装 Bean 的后处理器通常会实现postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String)。

Registration

`ApplicationContext` 可以在其 Bean 定义中自动检测 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean，并将这些后置处理器应用于随后创建的任何 Bean。普通的 `BeanFactory` 允许通过编程方式注册后置处理器，并将其应用于通过该 Bean Factory 创建的所有 Bean。

Ordering

在 `ApplicationContext` 中自动检测到的 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean 将按照PriorityOrdered和Ordered的语义进行排序。相比之下，通过编程方式向 `BeanFactory` 注册的 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean 将按注册顺序应用；对于通过编程方式注册的后置处理器，任何通过实现 `PriorityOrdered` 或 `Ordered` 接口所表达的排序语义都将被忽略。此外，`@Order` 注解不适用于 `BeanPostProcessor` Bean。

  • Method Details

    • postProcessBeforeInitialization

      default @Nullable Object postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object bean, String beanName) throws BeansException
      Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance before any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method). The bean will already be populated with property values. The returned bean instance may be a wrapper around the original.

      默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

      Parameters:
      bean - 新的 bean 实例
      beanName - 豆子的名称
      Returns:
      要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例；如果为null，则不会调用后续的 BeanPostProcessor。
      Throws:
      BeansException - 在发生错误时
      See Also:
      • InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()

    • postProcessAfterInitialization

      default @Nullable Object postProcessAfterInitialization(Object bean, String beanName) throws BeansException
      Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance after any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method). The bean will already be populated with property values. The returned bean instance may be a wrapper around the original.

      对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

      此回调也会在由`InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)`方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他`BeanPostProcessor`回调不同。

      默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

      Parameters:
      bean - 新的 bean 实例
      beanName - 豆子的名称
      Returns:
      要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例；如果为null，则不会调用后续的 BeanPostProcessor。
      Throws:
      BeansException - 在发生错误时
      See Also:
      • InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()
      • FactoryBean
